about: Vyshhorod and Petrivtsi: houses by the water

Vyshhorod stands on the high bank of the Dnipro next to the hydroelectric dam and the Kyiv Sea. Older apartment blocks, new complexes with water views and private houses mix here — in the town itself and in the villages along the road to Kyiv: Petrivtsi, Khotianivka, Liutizh.

Our Petrivtsi House is a 320 m² house in Petrivtsi: floor plans, a kitchen with an island and a fireplace, bathrooms, a laundry and a study. We bring that experience of a house for a large family by the water to every new project in the Vyshhorod area.

By the water we build the interior around the view: panoramic windows, terraces, a living room opening onto the garden. Materials are chosen for the humidity — natural wood only where it can cope, stone and porcelain stoneware in wet areas. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments, from older blocks to new builds, and turnkey houses; for flats overlooking the Dnipro we often do [premium renovation](/en/premium-renovation) with quiet ventilation. Plots by the water need careful foundation and waterproofing design, starting from the site survey; the site plan and landscape are planned from the outset.

The same salaried team as in Kyiv, at the same rates: renovation from $550 per m² (works and rough materials), and if CAS carries out the renovation, the final total stays within ±5% of the estimate. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m²; 12-month warranty on works. More on [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Our site managers include visits to the town in their normal schedule, just as for Kyiv districts, and materials come from Kyiv warehouses. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks; an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
